Sam — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and next steps.

Short answers / policy: 
- PO enrollment: we prefer one vendor record per legal entity. Reason: tax jurisdiction and entity-level POs. If you have a single tax ID for US/UK cross-entity billing, we can discuss a consolidated setup, but default is separate vendor records.

- Portal vs email: portal is the preferred, supported, and fastest path (better ack visibility, idempotency, and archive). Email is allowed as a fallback during activation windows, but: we require a subject token for automated ingestion if emailed (format: Redwood PO:<PO_NUMBER> or Subject contains "PO:#" — see example below). Without the token, emails go to a manual queue which delays payment.

- Required invoice fields for automated ingest (minimal): PO number, Invoice number, Invoice date (ISO), Invoice total and currency, Supplier legal name + tax ID (VAT/GST), Line items with description/qty/unit_price or a CSV of line-items with those columns. Optional but helpful: remit account id, invoice attachments (PDF) with the same filename token.

- Filenames & formats: Preferred filename pattern: PO{PO}_INV{INV}.pdf (example: PO12345_INV6789.pdf). Supported attachments: PDF (preferred), CSV for line items, XML for EDI partners. Max attachment size 10MB for email roadway; portal accepts up to 50MB.

Action items: 
1) Please complete and return the onboarding form (attached) with legal entity details per entity.
2) If you plan to email invoices during the first 90 days, use subject: "Redwood PO:12345" and attach files named PO12345_INV6789.pdf. That will route to automated ingest.
3) If you can share a sample invoice CSV (one or two rows), we'll validate field mapping in our test sandbox and confirm.

For visibility, looping in Vanessa (vendor activation) and Ben (AP ingestion team). Vanessa / Ben — can we provision Larkspur a portal invite once Sam returns the form, and run a quick ingest validation when they send the sample CSV?

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop

Sam — got the form, thanks and welcome aboard. Below are clarifying notes and a sample CSV layout to avoid mapping surprises.

Portal sign-on: yes — one Redwood portal account can be associated with multiple vendor records; good for your use case. We'll provision access after we create separate vendor records for each legal entity.

Split-PO invoices: we can accept multi-PO invoices. Preferred patterns: 
- Single invoice referencing multiple PO numbers should list each PO in a separate PO column (PO1, PO2 ...) OR in a single PO field separated by the pipe character ("|") — we recommend pipe over semicolon to avoid locale parsing issues. Our ingestion accepts pipe-separated lists and will split into individual PO matches.

VAT: For UK invoices please provide tax as either: (a) a tax_total field plus tax_rate, and include VAT as explicit line items if available. If you can't provide both, include tax_total at invoice level and indicate currency and VAT registration number on the invoice.

Sample minimal CSV (line items):
- header: invoice_number,invoice_date,po_list,line_number,description,quantity,unit_price,amount,currency,tax_total,supplier_tax_id
- example row: INV-2026-134,2026-06-01,12345|12346,1,Ocean freight,2,500.00,1000.00,USD,0.00,US-TAX-99

Subject token example for email ingest: Subject: Redwood PO:12345 — if multiple POs: Redwood PO:12345|12346 — the system will split on pipe.

Attachment filename examples we accept: PO12345_INV6789.pdf or PO12345_INV6789_LINEITEMS.csv

SFTP fallback: if you need machine-to-machine bulk push, we support push to sftp.redwood.com in /incoming/vendors/larkspur/ (credentials will be provided via secure doc once activation is approved).

Ack behavior: portal shows immediate ingest ack. Email ingest returns an automated receipt to the sender within ~10 minutes for successful parse; failures generate a failure note and a manual queue ticket with an SLA of 48 hours.

Next steps (recap):
1) We'll create two vendor records for Larkspur US / UK on our side.
2) Vanessa will send a portal invite to the email you listed.
3) Sam — please send one sample invoice CSV (as discussed) to our test inbox subject: "Redwood PO:12345" and add me + Ben on the email so we can validate mapping.

Welcome — Lauren
